eyebrow: Building a simple custom noise model
code:
from qiskit_aer.noise import NoiseModel, pauli_error

error = pauli_error([('X', 0.02), ('I', 0.98)])
noise_model = NoiseModel()
noise_model.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(error, ['x'])
caption: A 2% chance an x gate gets an extra X flip. On a fresh |0>, true P(0)=0.98, P(1)=0.02 under this channel.
Close to the injected 2%, not exact — the noise model's true probability, sampled by a finite number of shots.

eyebrow: Simulating a real device's actual profile
code:
from qiskit_aer.noise import NoiseModel

noise_model = NoiseModel.from_backend(backend)
caption: Built from the backend's live calibration data — actual measured gate errors, T1/T2 times, and readout errors.
